name: NewActionTypeDialog
intent: Four-step authoring wizard for an ontology action type: metadata, parameters, rules, review.
when: Adding a typed, permissioned operation to an ontology
Authoring an action whose rules create or delete objects and links
whenNot: Editing an existing action -> open its detail page

chooseOver.because: It carries the parameter and rule model — objectRef parameters, link and object rules, and the verb-prefix naming check — that a fresh copy would have to reinvent.

objectTypes.note: Offered to objectRef parameters and to the object rules.

functions.note: Backing functions when the action is function-backed.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Drafts carry no id; the host mints one on accept.

states.metadata: Display name, camelCased API name computed on blur, status.
states.parameters: Typed parameters, including objectRef parameters bound to an object type.
states.rules: Create/delete object and link rules over the declared parameters.
states.review: The assembled draft; submission criteria, side effects, layout and permissions are configured after creation.

minimalExample:
import {NewActionTypeDialog} from "@wakecap/core-ui/new-action-type-dialog";

<NewActionTypeDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} objectTypes={ots} linkTypes={lts} onCreate={addActionType} />
evaluationCriteria: The API name is camelCased on blur, never while typing.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted in group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
notes: Its chrome was copied from object-type-wizard.tsx; both should move onto WizardDialog.
Already an exported component with a typed props interface and no fixture coupling — this manifest is the only thing that was missing.
